issues.reason: Names and casing: the name is exactly the capitalized run and 'an adjacent lowercase common noun is not part of it', so 'the Bush administration' is (Name bush "Bush") with the kind stated separately — the Brindle-estuary example exactly.

The fused symbol half stands (it becomes (Member bush administration)), but emitting a kind atom is not itself the defect — the same rule requires that type atom, so this is issue 0's symbol error, not a second one.

'soldiers' is a bare plural, and the instruction set decides plurals by determiner — bare = generic kind, group witness only for a definite/demonstrative/possessed plural — so minting sk_soldier_1 asserts a specific set the text does not introduce; the bare class symbol is reserved for exactly this non-specific object.
'for putting them in Iraq' is a non-finite embedded eventuality, which 'carries no tense/status atom of its own unless its own grammar marks one', and the gerund marks none.
